metric_formulas.email_revenue: (Email Clicks × Conversion Rate × Avg Commission Per Click)
metric_formulas.video_completion_rate: Videos Watched to End ÷ Total Video Plays × 100
metric_formulas.video_revenue: (Total Views × Click Rate × Conversion Rate × Avg Commission)
metric_formulas.signal_ctr: Recipients Who Clicked Signal ÷ Total Signals Sent × 100
metric_formulas.signal_revenue: (Signals Sent × Signal CTR × Win Rate × Avg Profit Per Signal)
metric_formulas.daily_total_revenue: Email Revenue + Video Revenue + Trading Signal Revenue + Partner Revenue
